versions.content: Configurable behavior for DTC deletion Description: Usually, only ClearAllDTCs is used for the deletion of DTCs. Therefore, a configurable behavior which optionally limits the deletion of DTCs to ClearAllDTCs. Rationale: OEM specific behavior Use Case: Allow only ClearAllDTCs and therefore optimization of ClearDTC behavior. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – ▽ △ Supporting Material: –
